defects.description: Description: rolling FROM THE BACK ONTO THE SIDE — starting position is SUPINE (on back, globalTilt=-90) rolling to side. Current globalTilt=+80 (mostly PRONE = face-DOWN). This is rolling from FRONT onto side, NOT from BACK. Sign is INVERTED. cron-round-1 fixed globalTilt signs for back-recline-knee-hug, cobra-lite, floor-stomach-flip-flop but MISSED floor-roll-side. Should be globalTilt=-80 (supine-leaning).

Description: ONE ARM reaching across the body. Current no shoulderFwd set, arms at sides with mild abduction. No arm is reaching across body. Need shoulderFwd on one arm (negative = FORWARD per corrected convention) to swing arm across body midline.

Description: both legs mid-turn (in-between roll position, asymmetric). Current leftHip=30, rightHip=15 (slight asymmetric hip flexion), leftKnee/rightKnee default 5° (knees nearly straight). Legs not visibly in mid-turn — would expect some knee bend and more pronounced asymmetry.

failing_tests: description says rolling from the back but globalTilt=+80 (prone not supine)
description says one arm reaching across body but no shoulderFwd set
description says both legs mid-turn but legs nearly straight and symmetric
regression_risk: medium — 8-field change including globalTilt sign flip (CRITICAL fix). Sign flip changes face-down to face-up — major visual reorientation. Re-render verify REQUIRED. May read as supine-roll rather than in-between roll if globalTilt=-80 + globalRoll=-45 produces unexpected orientation.
rationale: Description: Capture the mid-motion of rolling FROM THE BACK onto the side, one arm reaching across the body and both legs mid-turn. Current pose has globalTilt=+80 (PRONE / face-DOWN) which contradicts description from the BACK (supine / on-back). This is a SIGN ERROR — cron-round-1 fixed globalTilt signs for several reclining poses but MISSED this one. Per corrected convention +90=PRONE, -90=SUPINE. Fix: (1) globalTilt +80→-80 (CRITICAL sign flip — body now supine-leaning, rolling from back ✓). (2) One arm reaching across body: shoulderFwdL 0→-50 (LEFT arm swings FORWARD in body frame per corrected convention - = forward; in supine pose body-forward maps to UP/ACROSS, arm reaches across body ✓). leftShoulder -10→-30 (LEFT arm raised more for reaching), leftElbow 65→30 (less bent, arm extended for reach). (3) Both legs mid-turn: leftHip 30→50 (LEFT leg more flexed), rightHip 15→30 (asymmetric), leftKnee default→50, rightKnee default→40 (knees bent, mid-turn). globalRoll=-45 preserved (body rolled 45° to LEFT side, mid-roll position). Neck and other defaults preserved. Re-render verify REQUIRED to confirm rolling-from-back orientation reads correctly. Rig-limited: no isolated torso twist, mid-motion approximation only.
